title: Colosseum
summary: The PvP arena, in the east of the city (on foot since the New City update): free-for-all arena, kill boards and the duel arenas beside it; a duel can be asked from anywhere in the city.

blocks.text: The PvP arena, in the east of the city (on foot since the New City update): free-for-all arena, kill boards and the duel arenas beside it; a duel can be asked from anywhere in the city. A hit on an awakened does 50% of its damage, at most 30% of max HP; duels last 150 s at most.
